question: If Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji, and Franky were to become ability users, then what kind of fruit do you think they would have eaten? -
answer: I see, that's quite a fun question~. Hmmm… what I would like to see is… *Zoro: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu (Fish Fish Fruit, Mythical Type Model: Seiryuu), "I'd want the sword to turn into a dragon rather than Zoro. I think that would be insanely cool." *Nami: Goro Goro no Mi (Rumble Rumble Fruit) (lightning human), "A true weather lady, now no one can stop her anymore (apart from Luffy). *Usopp: Poke Poke no Mi (Pocket Pocket Fruit) (infinite pockets in one's body), "The perfect pocket for someone like Usopp who always has something up his sleeve." *Sanji: Sui Sui no Mi (Swim Swim Fruit), "It allows one to slip through walls or swim on the ground. If given to Sanji, it would become quite the nasty ability." *Franky: Buki Buki no Mi (Arms Arms Fruit), "Can't get any better than this for an ability for Franky."
name: 420-land
